_doc: Paint product catalog. Hand-edited single source of truth for every paint product the project uses. Generators consume this and emit specs/_partials/paint-quantity-<scope-id>.md.
_pricing_rule: All paint is sold by the can (1 GL ≈ 3.78 L, 1/4 GL ≈ 0.95 L). Pricing is per can — quantities round up to whole cans. coverage_m2_per_can_per_coat is the manufacturer's spec for fresh paint on prepared substrate; in practice add a margin via the spec's notes.

concrete-primer.name: TOA Contact Primer 1GL
concrete-primer.notes: For chalky old plaster — bonds where standard primer would not.

concrete-topcoat.name: TOA SuperShield Sheen 1GL White G100
concrete-topcoat.notes: Must be Sheen finish — not Semi-Gloss, not SuperShield Advance.

metal-2in1.name: TOA GLIPTON 2IN1 GF888 Matt Black 1/4 GL
metal-2in1.notes: Combined primer + topcoat. Applies directly to wire-brushed surface rust. Supersedes the older TOA MD 2IN1 MG999 (HomePro 1193569). Use for ALL project metalwork.
